description: Open Badges 2.0 / 3.0 credential verifier — Verifies an Open Badges credential end to end and says what could and could not be confirmed. Accepts an Open Badges 3.0 credential (JSON with an eddsa-jcs-2022 proof, or a VC-JWT signed with EdDSA, ES256 or RS256), an Open Badges 2.0 assertion (hosted, or signed as an RS256 JWS), a hosted-assertion URL, or a baked PNG or SVG image. Checks the 2.0/3.0 required fields, the issuance and expiry windo

credential.description: The credential or assertion as a JSON object (or the same as a JSON string, or a compact JWS string).

image.description: A baked badge image, base64 (data URLs accepted): a PNG with an openbadges iTXt chunk, or an SVG with an openbadges:assertion or openbadges:credential element. Up to 6 MB decoded.

jws.description: A compact JWS: an Open Badges 3.0 VC-JWT or an Open Badges 2.0 signed assertion.

recipientIdentity.description: Optional: the recipient's email or other identity to compare against the badge's recipient, including salted sha256$ and md5$ hashes.

url.description: https URL of a hosted Open Badges 2.0 assertion or a hosted 3.0 credential.

name: open-badges-verifier
